title: Jothe Jotheyali
desc: Prem and Divya, a couple, are on the verge of getting a divorce. By a twist of fate, their lives take a surprising turn when one of them gets kidnapped.

title: Abraham Ozler
desc: Seasoned cop Abraham Ozler delves into an enigmatic cold case, sparking a relentless pursuit of a cunning serial killer.

title: Bhupathi
desc: After Bhupathi's mother and niece are attacked by the thugs of his lover's father, he decides to take revenge and turn his back on his lady.

title: Natasaarvabhowma
desc: An investigative journalist, Gagan, moves to Bengaluru and ends up living in a supposedly haunted house. Soon, he realises a change in his behaviour after falling prey to supernatural activities.

title: Shakthi
desc: Sakthi dreams of becoming a superhero. His wish unexpectedly comes true when the girl he is helping secure college admission dies due to unforeseen circumstances.

title: Stunt Master
desc: Pooja, a college girl, does not believe in love. Her friends put forth a challenge that she should be friends with a man for thirty days without falling in love with him, but things go awry.

title: Aaradhane
desc: A religious leader performs sacred rituals and worships the idol of a Hindu deity while chanting holy hymns to seek divine blessings.

title: Teleshopping
desc: Learn about a wide selection of products and take advantage of a convenient method of shopping. A show for those who love to shop from the comforts of their home.

title: Aathma Bandhana
desc: After Vaishnavi is mercilessly killed by her in-laws, her spirit enters a doll which seeks revenge against everyone responsible for Vaishnavi's death.

title: Rajani
desc: Rajani, an unemployed software engineer, falls in love with Sandhya. However, their relationship is threatened by a gangster who stalks and harasses Sandhya.
